description: The chaining features used together, for a long clip driven by a supplied soundtrack. 'match_audio' sizes the chain to the audio while 'last_segment' continuity carries motion and framing across the seams, with 'carry_audio' off because the segments already take their audio from the supplied track rather than from each other. Also shows 'prompts', which lets a chain say something different on its opening segment than on its continuations, and 'save_segments', which writes each finished segment to disk so memory stays bounded to one segment and a crashed run keeps its progress.

variables.first_segment_prompt:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the cartoon astronaut in <Picture 1>, whose face, hair, clothing and proportions define their appearance for the whole video.
<Audio 1> is the speech track <Subject 1> (S1) is lip-synchronised to: a single continuous recorded voiceover, even in level and unhurried in delivery.

summary:
[image reference + audio speech reference] The target video shows <Subject 1> delivering the speech carried by <Audio 1> directly to camera in the setting of <Picture 1>, in one continuous take that runs to the end of the clip without resolving.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - the face, hair, clothing and proportions of <Picture 1> are kept exactly, with the head, jaw and shoulders newly animated to speak.
<Audio 1>: partially_copy - the segment of the recording covering this part of the timeline is reused as <Subject 1>'s speech, and the mouth is synchronised to it.

detailed_description:
The target video is in realistic photographic style. [Shot 1] A medium close-up frames <Subject 1> from the chest up, centred and facing camera in the setting of <Picture 1>, held as one continuous shot. The lighting of <Picture 1> is kept exactly as it is, steady and unchanging across the whole clip, and the background sits well behind in shallow focus. <Subject 1> (S1) speaks continuously, the jaw and lips moving in natural synchronisation with <Audio 1> and pausing only where the recording pauses. Between phrases <Subject 1> shifts weight very slightly and the head drifts a few degrees off centre and back, with the eyes staying on the lens and blinking at a natural rate. The camera holds a static shot throughout. The clip ends mid-delivery with <Subject 1> still speaking, the pose, framing and lighting unchanged from the rest of the shot.

overall_soundscape:
A quiet, close room tone at an even level from the first frame to the last, with no doors, footsteps or movement in the room, and faint clothing rustle as <Subject 1> shifts weight.

non_diegetic_music:
None.

<Audio 1>: partially_copy - the segment of the recording covering this part of the timeline is reused as <Subject 1>'s speech, and the mouth is synchronised to it.

Between phrases <Subject 1> shifts weight very slightly and the head drifts a few degrees off centre and back, with the eyes staying on the lens and blinking at a natural rate. overall_soundscape:
